node.label: Anomalous origin of right coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
node.definition: Right coronary artery begins (branches off from) the pulmonary artery rather than as normal from the root of the aorta, above the right cusp of the aortic valve.

evidence.snippet: Acrofacial dysostosis, Cincinnati type: Anomalous origin of right coronary artery from the pulmonary artery (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
